hivemindAdaptations: Clean-room HivemindOS-authored implementation of the published-call accountability pattern from public research-workflow writeups; no upstream text is vendored.
Ledgers live in the user's shared brain vault under Operations/Research/ and are seeded from bundled templates when absent.
Publish-time fail-closed rule: a call with no tracker row is a blocker to surface, not a detail to skip.
Win rate is computed from Closed rows only, and historical rows are never rewritten to improve the record.
